I told Marcus in a thread reply on his message in #north-team that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is **10 June**.

- **Where the date comes from:** Ilse first posted 25 November in #north-team on 14 October. Later that morning she corrected it in #north-random, saying she'd read the wrong line. I read #north-random and it confirms what's in my memory.
- **Why I could share it in #north-team:** Marcus is in #north-random, and so is everyone else in #north-team (Dana, Ilse, Marcus), so the correction wasn't news to anyone in the channel. A renewal date is also an account detail, not a finance figure.
- **What's still open:** Ilse didn't give a year. I asked Marcus to check the year with her or the contract before updating the account sheet.
